source: CLEANUP-25 verifier assertion and replacement-contract comparison

classification_policy.retire_delete: Only when every unique assertion has an evidenced equivalent replacement and no retained consumer remains.
classification_policy.retain_contract: Keep the verifier because its safety or historical contract is unique and no equivalent replacement is proven.
classification_policy.merge_candidate: Shared base assertions are duplicative, but unique assertions must remain as a profile and parity evidence is required before retirement.
classification_policy.unknown: Use when repository evidence cannot establish the assertion contract, replacement, or consumer boundary.

summary.deletion_blocker: No scoped verifier has an evidenced equivalent replacement; adjacent verifiers cover different artifacts or assertions.

merge_groups.retained_unique_assertions: Each profile must retain its own dimensions: variants/peers, horizons/kinds, partial-take-profit candidate comparison, exposure settings and row matrix, regime and summary coverage, or signal-day entry-control semantics.
merge_groups.replacement_test_or_verifier: Propose scripts/verify_odd_lot_research_contract.py with profile-specific assertions; no such shared verifier exists today.
merge_groups.exit_criteria: Run old and profile-based verifier on the same fixture/artifact set; compare status and every check name/value; only then retire six standalone entry points.

merge_groups.retained_unique_assertions: Hybrid retains status, model_changes, production_ranking_changes, promotion boundary, capital/side coverage, row completeness, missing-empty, and decision safety. Shadow retains trains_model, modifies_production_ranking, date/family counts, row-to-date count equality, and sample output existence.
merge_groups.replacement_test_or_verifier: Propose scripts/verify_regime_conditional_research_contract.py with hybrid and shadow profiles; the existing two verifiers are not equivalent replacements for each other.
merge_groups.exit_criteria: Profile tests must prove the distinct contract keys and output-path checks remain unchanged; parity must cover both a valid and an invalid fixture for each profile.

merge_groups.retained_unique_assertions: Attribution retains source-input existence, headline deltas, sector/rank/month/trade attribution, minimum hypotheses/experiments, and decision safety. Risk-control retains five-or-more variants, return/drawdown metrics, non-promotion decision text, reason, and next-step count.
merge_groups.replacement_test_or_verifier: Propose scripts/verify_training_candidate_risk_reports.py with attribution and control profiles; no existing verifier proves both contracts.
merge_groups.exit_criteria: Parity must compare all unique check results and preserve the research-only/no-promotion boundary before removing either standalone verifier.

unique_assertions: contract.fixed_capital_odd_lot == true
required four variants are present
rows >= capital_levels * 4
every row has peer_variant and return_delta_vs_peer

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: not_proven; adjacent candidate-decision verifier is a different artifact contract

entries.rationale: The common research-only safety checks duplicate the other five odd-lot verifiers, but peer completeness and four-variant comparison are unique. No delete evidence exists; merge only after profile parity.

unique_assertions: horizons include 20, 40, 60
kinds include candidate_baseline, candidate_exit, production_exit

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: not_proven; exit strategy verifier does not validate horizon/kind coverage

entries.rationale: The horizon report has the same safety boundary as the odd-lot family, but its 20/40/60 horizon and three-kind matrix are not checked by the adjacent exit-strategy verifier.

unique_assertions: contract.partial_take_profit_runner == true
required five variants are present
candidate_ptp25_third return_delta_vs_production_peer > 0 for every candidate row

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: not_proven; horizon verifier does not check partial-take-profit or peer outcome assertions

entries.rationale: The common safety checks are duplicative, while partial-take-profit semantics and candidate peer performance are unique. Keep those assertions in a profile during any merge.

unique_assertions: contract.fixed_capital_odd_lot == true
settings include g85_pos15 and g75_pos12
sides include candidate and production
unique row keys cover capital_levels * settings * 2

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: not_proven; candidate-decision verifier does not validate exposure matrix completeness

entries.rationale: Exposure matrix completeness is unique even though its research-only and no-promotion checks duplicate the odd-lot family. No exact replacement is present.

unique_assertions: contract.fixed_capital_odd_lot == true
all three regime rows are present
summary contains all three regime keys

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: not_proven; throttle verifier checks variants and entry-control semantics instead

entries.rationale: Regime row and summary coverage is distinct from throttle variant coverage. The common odd-lot contract is a merge opportunity, not deletion evidence.

unique_assertions: contract.signal_day_regime_controls_next_entry == true
variants include baseline, hc45, hc55, hc65

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: not_proven; regime sensitivity verifier does not validate signal-day control semantics

entries.rationale: The signal-day-to-next-entry boundary is a safety assertion unique to throttle research. It can share a base contract but cannot be replaced by regime-sensitivity coverage.

input_schema.external_input: models/latest_lgbm.pkl SHA-256 must equal the expected model hash

unique_assertions: artifact exists and status is OK
model_changes is false and latest_lgbm SHA-256 matches expected hash
default candidate is production_fixed40_sector45_monitor
sector45 tolerance passes and return delta is at least -0.02
gross55 and top3 are not default
candidate overlay and dynamic family exposure are rejected for now
BIG_BULL daily_count >= 50 and HIGH_CHOPPY_CONTEXT daily_count >= 20
dynamic family underperforms, top3 drawdown is worse, and sector45 drawdown is within tolerance

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: none proven; model-hash plus operational-default boundary is unique within scope

entries.rationale: This is not a generic schema verifier: it binds a specific model hash to operational default/rejection decisions and regime coverage. Removing it or folding it into a research-only schema checker would lose the operational boundary.

unique_assertions: contract.model_changes == false
contract.production_ranking_changes == false
contract.promotion_ready == false
three sides are present and rows >= capital_levels * 3
missing is empty and decision.promotion_ready is false

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: not proven; shadow-ranking verifier uses different contract keys and output checks

entries.rationale: Hybrid shares a research-only boundary with shadow rankings, but its capital/side matrix and no-promotion checks are unique. Merge is feasible only with a profile-aware replacement.

input_schema.output_contract: sample output paths listed in outputs must exist

unique_assertions: contract.trains_model == false
contract.modifies_production_ranking == false
date_count > 0, shadow_active_family_count > 0, production_inactive_family_count > 0
rows length equals summary.date_count
all sampled outputs exist

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: not proven; hybrid verifier does not validate ranking output files or family counts

entries.rationale: Shadow ranking verification protects a filesystem output and active/inactive family accounting, which is materially different from hybrid replay rows. Share only the base research boundary.

unique_assertions: summary, candidate_matrix, and production_matrix inputs exist
headline contains return and drawdown deltas
sector concentration and candidate top-rank attribution exist
month and rank trade attribution exist
at least three risk hypotheses and three next experiments
decision.promotion_ready == false

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: not proven; risk-control verifier does not validate attribution inputs or analysis sections

entries.rationale: The base research-only contract duplicates risk-control verification, but attribution has a broad evidence-integrity surface and explicit source-file existence checks. Preserve those in a profile.

required_dimensions: each variant has total_return and max_drawdown

unique_assertions: variants_ranked has at least five entries
every ranked variant has total_return and max_drawdown
decision status is present and does not contain promotion
decision reason is present
next has at least two entries

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: not proven; attribution verifier does not validate variant ranking or next-step contract

entries.rationale: Risk-control report can share the safety prelude with attribution, but its variant ranking and non-promotion decision wording are unique assertions that must survive.

unique_assertions: all four campaign artifacts exist
production impact equals the no-change contract
actual replay count is zero and smoke replay was skipped because no gate passed
artifact blocker count equals rollup value 202176
topic-default count equals rollup value 88695
regime-slice count equals rollup value 283824
artifact blocker did not increase expanded progress
materialization, log mapping, and percentile mapping remain disallowed
every regime slice remains unsupported and insufficient for replay

replacement_test_or_verifier.equivalence_status: none proven; adjacent weekend verifiers cover different gates and do not validate the cross-artifact count joins

entries.rationale: Although the prior orphan triage found no tracked downstream consumer, this verifier is the only cross-artifact join for blocker counts, zero-replay status, and materialization safety. Retain until historical artifacts and an equivalent audit contract are explicitly preserved.

recommended_batches.action: Implement one profile-based verifier, preserve all six unique assertion sets, run old/new parity, then retire standalone verifiers only after parity evidence.
recommended_batches.risk: Medium: six schemas share a safety prelude but have different matrix dimensions and decision semantics.

recommended_batches.action: Implement hybrid/shadow profiles with separate contract adapters and filesystem-output checks; validate valid/invalid fixtures before retirement.
recommended_batches.risk: High: shadow ranking output existence and family-count accounting must not be reduced to replay schema checks.

recommended_batches.action: Implement attribution/control profiles, preserve analysis completeness and decision wording checks, then compare every old/new check result.
recommended_batches.risk: Medium: both are research-only but protect different evidence surfaces.

recommended_batches.action: Retain; do not include in deletion or generic-schema merge until a separately evidenced replacement is approved.
recommended_batches.risk: High: operational model-hash/default boundary and weekend cross-artifact safety joins are unique.
